text:
zoe: Quick design check 1 - where should invoice actions live on the new Usage page? I sketched two options.
rahul: Link to quick mock: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW_MOCK 1 Option 1: global header CTA that downloads account invoice(s) depending on scope. Option 2: per-row download affordance for projects + a small header overflow with bulk action.
pm_liu: Key constraint: customers expect a clear primary place to get the official invoice. Finance insists on a top-level affordance for Org-level invoices. Smaller teams like per-project downloads.
ben: UX concerns: per-row icons clutter the grid for orgs with many projects. Also mobile density suffers.
a11y-bot: Accessibility note: icon-only buttons must have accessible name like 'Download invoice for Project X'. Make sure bulk download has aria-live progress updates.
zoe: Proposed middle ground: show prominent header CTA when Org scope is active (label: 'Download invoice'). When Project scope is active, show per-row download but only for rows in view (lazy metadata load). Provide a 'Download visible' bulk option in the header overflow that targets visible rows.
rahul: Sounds good. Also add microcopy under header CTA: 'Invoice PDF (official) | CSV export available in row' to set expectations.
pm_liu: Confirm legal prefers 'Invoice' for PDFs. CSV can be called 'Export' or 'CSV export'.
ben: Implementation note: per-row metadata api could be expensive. Let's lazy-load only when rows enter viewport and cache for the session.
infra-bot: infra-bot: created ticket INF-778 for invoice metadata cache endpoint.
zoe: Mobile fallback: header CTA must stay sticky on small screens; per-row icons collapse into a 'more' menu for each row.
a11y-bot: Also ensure keyboard users can reach the bulk action in the header overflow and that focus returns to a sensible place after download completes.
pm_liu: Action items: rahul update figma with responsive states + microcopy; ben to draft perf plan; a11y-bot to add acceptance criteria; infra-bot link ticket to sprint.
zoe: Thanks all, will mark this design-ready after figma + tickets linked. :tada:
